# Dashboards

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_release_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

The panels a release is read from, generated from the emitters that exist in
`src` rather than from the events somebody remembers adding. Every row below
is a marked call site, which is the same list `GateMetrics.spec`,
`TuningMetrics.spec` and `CommerceAnalytics.spec` hold against their
documents -- so a panel here cannot name an event nothing emits, and an
emitter cannot exist with no panel to read it.

**A dashboard reading zero and a dashboard reading nothing look identical to
the person approving a release.** That sentence is why the emitters were built
in #336 and it is why this document is generated: a panel list typed by hand
is a list that quietly stops matching the game.

Building the panels themselves is the owner's -- this says what each one is of.

## Release gates

One panel per gate in [RELEASE_GATES.md](RELEASE_GATES.md). Every one is a rate over instants and every one is sliced by the session pair, so each panel needs the platform class and performance tier as filters rather than as separate panels.

12 panels.

| Panel | Gate | Emitted from |
|---|---|---|
| `first_night_completed` | First-night completion after onboarding | `TutorialService.luau` |
| `generator_fallback` | Impossible critical-path expedition seeds in the candidate suite or live cohort; Generator fallback rate | `ExpeditionService.luau` |
| `interactive_session` | Interactive join p95; D1 return; D7 return | `PerformanceService.luau` |
| `join_failed` | Join failure rate | `PerformanceService.luau` |
| `profile_transaction` | Profile load/save transaction success | `ProfileService.luau` |
| `purchase_loss` | Duplicate purchase grants or a completed receipt permanently missing its grant; Receipt retry, server shutdown, full inventory, and archive compaction produce no duplicate grants | `CommerceService.luau` |
| `purchase_platform_result` | Canceled prompts produce no receipt and no grant | `CommerceService.luau` |
| `receipt_result` | 100% of completed platform receipts eventually reach exactly one durable grant and one archived purchase tombstone; At least 99.5% of completed receipts reach the durable grant within 60 seconds | `CommerceService.luau` |
| `save_loss` | Confirmed save loss or unrecoverable save corruption | `ProfileService.luau` |
| `session_ended` | Crash-free interactive sessions | `PerformanceService.luau` |
| `tutorial_completed` | Onboarding completion | `TutorialService.luau` |
| `unauthorized_mutation` | Unauthorized economy, entitlement, admin, or progression mutation | `AdminService.luau`, `TutorialService.luau` |

## Beta tuning

One panel per decision in [BETA_TUNING.md](BETA_TUNING.md). These are not rates: a tuning number is about a stretch of play, so each panel is a distribution over attempts rather than a percentage over instants, and a single average is the one shape that hides the answer.

5 panels.

| Panel | Decision | Emitted from |
|---|---|---|
| `difficulty_checkpoint` | Find difficulty cliffs | `BramblewakeBlackoutService.luau`, `OldGrowthService.luau`, `TutorialService.luau`, `WardenStagService.luau` |
| `first_night_outcome` | Tune the first night | `TutorialService.luau` |
| `first_session_end` | Tune the first session | `PerformanceService.luau` |
| `group_outcome` | Tune group scaling | `ExpeditionService.luau` |
| `repeat_activity` | Tune repetition | `ExpeditionService.luau` |

## Commerce

One panel per event in [MONETIZATION_LIVEOPS_ANALYTICS.md](MONETIZATION_LIVEOPS_ANALYTICS.md). They are four separate events rather than one `purchase` for the reason [COMMERCE_SUPPORT.md](COMMERCE_SUPPORT.md) is organised around: "I bought it and I do not have it" means four different things and a merged event cannot tell them apart.

6 panels.

| Panel | Decision | Emitted from |
|---|---|---|
| `cosmetic_equipped` | purchase funnel | `CommerceService.luau` |
| `product_detail_view` | purchase funnel | `CommerceService.luau` |
| `purchase_platform_result` | purchase funnel | `CommerceService.luau` |
| `purchase_prompt` | purchase funnel | `CommerceService.luau` |
| `receipt_result` | purchase funnel | `CommerceService.luau` |
| `store_view` | purchase funnel | `CommerceService.luau` |
